interested parties and pursuant to a full and public hearing affording due process at which the testimony of all interested parties was taken and fully considered, hereby states its full approval of the Company and the adequacy and desirability of its construction arrangements therefore grants to the Company the right and privilege to construct, erect, operate and maintain in, upon, along, across, above, over and under the streets, alleys and public ways, now laid out or dedicated and all extensions thereof and additions thereto in the County wires, poles, cables, underground conduits, conductors and fixtures necessary for the maintenance and operation in the County ofa Community Antenna Television System for the reception and distribution of television signals and energy, frequently modulated radio signals and noncommercial visual and aural signals, which are not otherwise herein prohibited. The right to use and occupy said streets, alleys, public ways and places for the purposes of constructing and maintaining a cable system for the County of Treutlen shall not be exclusive, and the County reserves the right to grant the use of streets, alleys, public ways and places to any person at any time during the period of the Franchise Ordinance for any lawful purposes. The rights herein conveyed shall remain in effect so long as the Company is not in default upon the terms of this Franchise Ordinance.

The Company shall have the right to enter into arrangements for the attachment onto and the use of facilities owned and operated by public utilities operating within the County, whereby the Company shall strictly comply with the terms, provisions and restrictions of said agreements, and copies of all agreements made with other public utilities operating within the County shall be made available to the County upon reasonable request.
5: The Company shall, at all times during the life of this Franchise Ordinance, be subject to all lawful exercise of the police power by the County and to such reasonable regulation as the County shall hereafter by Resolution or Ordinance provide. The construction, operation and maintenance of the System by the Company shall be in full compliance with the National Electrical Safety Code as from time to time amended and revised, and in full compliance with all other applicable rules and regulations now in effect or hereinafter adopted by the F.C.C., the County, the State of Georgia and the United States Government. This Franchise is deemed reasonable and will not be amended or altered through an exercise of the police powers, except as provided for by regulation by the F.C.C. Further if the County provides a similar franchise to another party in the future with terms and conditions that are more favorable, the County will offer the same terms and conditions to the Plant Telenet, Incorporated.

- a. LIABILITY COVERAGE. It is expressly understood and agreed by and between the County and the Company that the Company shall save the County harmless from all loss sustained by the County on account of any suit, judgment, execution, claim or demand whatsoever arising out of the construction, operations and maintenance of

the System by the Company. The Company agrees to maintain and keep in full force and effect at all times during the term of the Franchise Ordinance sufficient liability insurance coverage to protect the County against any such claims, suits, judgments, executions or demands in a sum not less than $1,000,000.00 per person in any one claim, $1,000.000.00 as to any one accident or occurrence, and not less than $1,000,000.00 for property damage as to any one accident or occurrence, or in such larger sums on all coverage as may be required of the Company by any other public utility in the County.

- b. WORKERS’ COMPENSATION COVERAGE. The Company shall also maintain in full force and effect throughout the duration of this Franchise Ordinance sufficient Workers’ Compensation insurance coverage to adequately and fully protect its agents and employees and required by law.

Cc. RESIDENT COMPANY AND AGENT. All insurance policies as are required by the Company in this Franchise Ordinance shall be written by a company or companies authorized and qualified to do business in the State of Georgia. Certificates of all coverage shall be promptly filed by the Company with the County.
7:
- a. USE. All transmission and distributions structures, lines and equipment erected by the Company within the County shall be so located as to cause minimum interference with the proper use of streets alleys and other public ways and places and to cause minimum interference with the proper use of, and the rights of, reasonable convenience of property owners who adjoin any of said streets, alleys or other public ways and places.

- b. RESTORATION. In case of any disturbance of pavement, sidewalks, driveways or other surfacing, the Company shall, at its own expense and in a manner approved by the County, replace and restore such places so disturbed in as good condition as before said work was commenced, and if said Company fails to do so after thirty (30) days written notice, the County may undertake such restoration at the expense of the Company.

¢. RELOCATION. In the event that any time during the period of this Franchise Ordinance the County shall lawfully select or alter or change the grade of alignment of any street, alley or other public way, the Company upon reasonable written notice by the County, shall remove, relay and relocate its equipment at its own expense.

- d. PLACEMENT OF FIXTURES. The Company shall not place any fixture or equipment where the same will interfere with any existing gas, electric, telephone or sewer or water lines, fixtures and equipment, and the location by the Company of its lines and equipment shall be in such manner as to not interfere with the usual travel on said streets, alleys and public ways and the use of the same by gas, electric, telephone and water and sewer lines and equipment.

- e. TEMPORARY REMOVAL OF WIRES FOR BUILDING MOVING. The Company shall, on the request of the County, temporarily raise or lower its wires to permit the moving of buildings, but may reserve the right to recover their costs from the person or persons moving said building.

- f. NO PROPERTY RIGHT. Nothing in the Franchise Ordinance shall grant to the Company any right of property in County-owned property, nor shall the County be compelled to maintain any of its property any longer than, or in any fashion other than in the County’s judgment, its own business or needs may require.

- g. NON-LIABILITY OF COUNTY. The County shall not be liable for any damage occurring to the property of the Company or be held liable for the interruption of

service or the failure of the Company to be able to perform normal services do to acts of God or acts by the County, its officers or employees beyond the normal scope of liability for municipalities under the general statutes of the State of Georgia.

- h. PERMITS, EASEMENTS AND AGREEMENTS. The County shall not be required to assume any responsibility for securing of any rights-of-way or easements, nor shall the County be responsible for securing any permits or agreements with other persons or utilities.

- i. PLATS, MAPS AND RECORDS. Plant Telenet, Incorporated shall prepare and maintain full and complete plats, maps and records designating the exact location of all the cables, distribution system and equipment located and used by them within the County and copies of said plats, maps and records shall be furnished to the Chairman of the County Commissioner upon request.
